We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele. Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do. Main Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution. Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay. Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity. Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage. Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues. Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track. Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations. Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed. Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives. Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding. Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms. Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start. Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools. Required Experience Prior experience in the patent filing industry;
experience as a patentfiling paralegal is strongly preferred. Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings. Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms. Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting. Skills & Competencies -IP Knowledge & Process Orientation Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines. Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks. A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality. -Client Focus & Communication Genuine commitment to client service — you take ownership of queries, communicate proactively, and never let a matter fall through the cracks. Professional written and verbal communication skills, including polished client-facing email correspondence and confident participation in meetings. Calm and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage urgent, time-sensitive matters without compromising accuracy or client experience. -Organization & Problem Solving Exceptional attention to detail: you spot errors, inconsistencies, and omissions that others miss, and you act on them decisively. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent matters across varying deadlines. Confident problem-solver who identifies root causes, considers options, and implements solutions - escalating only where genuinely necessary. Ability to manage high-volume shared inboxes effectively, ensuring timely, organized, and consistent responses. -Technical Proficiency Accurate and efficient data entry. Proficiency across multiple software platforms and case management systems;

title: Engenheiro(A) / Arquiteto(A) De Plataforma Ia & Mcp
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro(A) / Arquiteto(A) De Plataforma Ia & Mcp em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Atuar como referência técnica na construção e evolução da plataforma corporativa de Inteligência Artificial baseada em MCP (Model Context Protocol), sendo responsável pela arquitetura, integração e governança de agentes inteligentes, ferramentas e APIs corporativas. Desenvolver soluções escaláveis, seguras e orientadas a eventos que permitam a orquestração de agentes de IA conectados aos ecossistemas de negócio da empresa, promovendo automação cognitiva, interoperabilidade e reutilização de contexto entre sistemas enterprise. Responsabilidades & Atribuições Desenvolver e evoluir arquiteturas baseadas em MCP (Model Context Protocol) para integração entre agentes de IA, ferramentas e sistemas corporativos. Construir e sustentar MCP Servers, AI Gateways e hubs de ferramentas reutilizáveis para consumo por agentes inteligentes. Desenvolver integrações entre agentes IA e APIs corporativas, ERPs, CRMs, sistemas financeiros, plataformas de dados e sistemas legados. Atuar na construção de arquiteturas multiagentes com foco em orquestração, compartilhamento de contexto, tool calling e reasoning distribuído. Desenvolver soluções de AI Platform voltadas para escalabilidade, governança, observabilidade e segurança de agentes. Construir APIs e microsserviços para exposição segura de dados e ferramentas corporativas para agentes inteligentes. Participar da definição de padrões técnicos para interoperabilidade entre agentes, ferramentas e plataformas de IA. Garantir autenticação, autorização, auditoria e governança de acessos em ambientes MCP enterprise. Trabalhar na abstração de sistemas legados através de camadas inteligentes de APIs e ferramentas reutilizáveis. Implementar mecanismos de observabilidade, tracing e monitoramento para ecossistemas de IA. Desenvolver arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para comunicação entre agentes e serviços distribuídos. Participar da definição de estratégias de segurança para agentes inteligentes, prevenindo abuso de ferramentas, vazamento de contexto e acessos indevidos. Trabalhar com arquiteturas cloud-native e ambientes distribuídos em larga escala. Colaborar com times de arquitetura, segurança, cloud, dados e IA para evolução contínua da plataforma. Conduzir POCs e iniciativas estratégicas envolvendo IA Generativa, agentes autônomos, AI orchestration e integração enterprise. Participar da evolução da estratégia de AI Platform da companhia, promovendo reutilização, padronização, governança e escalabilidade. Obrigatórias / Essenciais Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend e arquitetura distribuída. Experiência com Python, Node.Js, Go ou Java em ambientes enterprise. Conhecimento prático em MCP (Model Context Protocol), Tool Calling e integração de agentes inteligentes. Experiência com APIs REST, GraphQL, microsserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos. Conhecimento em arquiteturas multiagentes e frameworks de orquestração de IA. Experiência com LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen ou frameworks similares. Experiência com LLMs e integração com plataformas OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Azure OpenAI ou similares. Conhecimento em RAG, embeddings, memória contextual e vector databases. Experiência com cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP). Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes e pipelines CI/CD. Conhecimento em autenticação, autorização e segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, IAM). Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, LangSmith ou similares). Conhecimento em arquitetura de integração corporativa e exposição segura de ferramentas para agentes IA. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes enterprise de alta escalabilidade e criticidade. Forte visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos. Boa comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e executivas. Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e integração com fornecedores globais.

title: Sap Logistics Solution Architect - Sd & Mm
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sap Logistics Solution Architect - Sd & Mm em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SAP Logistics Solution Architect – SD & MM About Pyxus We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. Our mission is to produce high-quality products and ingredients through sustainable practices, ensuring social, environmental, and production traceability, while promoting the well-being of farmers and the communities we serve. As part of the Pyxus group, Alliance One Brasil shares this vision, and we believe in a future where people are inspired to achieve excellence, communities are strengthened by trust and innovation, and value is created through a commitment to serve. Our culture is built on resilience, accountability, encouragement, and transparency, and we value each team member for their experience, knowledge, and passion. Join Pyxus and help us grow a better world together! Key Responsibilities Leads end-to-end SAP logistics architecture (OTC and PTP), defining global templates and ensuring integration with core modules and external systems. Partners with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions and governs adherence to standards and architecture principles. Designs and integrates complex SD and MM solutions (pricing, billing, transport, procurement, inventory), prioritizing standard SAP functionality. Drives S/4HANA transformation initiatives, defining target architecture, supporting conversions, and promoting Fiori and modern UX. Ensures quality and compliance through testing strategies, audit alignment, and support for go-live, hypercare, and production stability. Promotes continuous improvement by driving simplification, automation, process optimization, and resolving critical production issues. Qualifications/Requirements Fluent English Strong SAP experience with deep expertise in SD and MM Proven Solution Architect or Lead Functional Consultant experience Strong understanding of end‐to‐end logistics and supply chain processes Hands‐on experience with S/4HANA implementations or conversions Experience in global, multi‐company, multi‐country SAP environments Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills Benefits Profit-Sharing Program (PPR) Health Insurance Plans 50% Medication Allowance Mobile Phone Plan Private Pension Plan Meal Card Employee Assistance Program – Mental Health and Well-being Corporate Time Off Days Wellhub Group Life Insurance All opportunities offered by Alliance One consider candidates' alignment with our STAR values (Supportive, Transparent, Adaptable, and Responsible), in addition to fostering an inclusive culture committed to social responsibility and equity. This includes Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Race, Ethnicity, and Religion.

title: Technical Project Manager (Ai Portfolio)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager (Ai Portfolio) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment. We are looking for a Technical Project Manager (AI Portfolio). In this role you will: Manage intake of AI use cases from CMC business and digital leadership, ensuring initiatives are clearly defined, prioritized, and actively managed Ensure alignment between AI initiatives, business outcomes, and enterprise priorities Drive portfolio-level actions, decisions, and follow-ups across multiple AI programs and workstreams Identify interdependencies, risks, and capacity constraints across the portfolio and proactively drive resolution Maintain standardized tracking for portfolio actions, statuses, risks, issues, and dependencies Track and report on portfolio KPIs to provide insight on the portfolio status Produce executive-ready reporting for leadership forums Implement and evolve portfolio governance mechanisms, including intake, prioritization, and escalation processes Drive continuous improvement in portfolio management practices, tooling, and reporting maturity Facilitate portfolio-level forms, working sessions, and reviews Lead projects as necessary: Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestone tracking, RAID logs, and governance materials Drive execution of work, report on project statuses, and elevate risks, issues, and decisions to governing bodies Ensure assigned projects adhere to applicable regulatory, validation, security, and data governance requirements Influence without authority to drive accountability, resolve blockers, and maintain momentum We have some requirements: Background/previous experience in Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences Industry Solid experience as PMO - ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously Experience working with AI/ML initiatives Demonstrated experience building and maintaining portfolio-level reporting and dashboards Compliance-focused mindset Familiarity with GxP, validation, or regulated environments A bachelor's degree in STEM or another relevant academic discipline Fluent English What do we offer? TCS Benefits – Brazil: Health insurance Dental Plan Life insurance Transportation vouchers Meal/Food Voucher Childcare assistance Totalpass TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates Partnership with SESC Reimbursement of Certifications Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training International experience opportunity Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire TCS Gems – Recognition for performance Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform Tata Consultancy Services is an equal opportunity employer, our commitment to diversity & inclusion drives our efforts to provide equal opportunity to all candidates who meet our required knowledge & competency needs, irrespective of any socio-economic background, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity/expression, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation or any others. We encourage anyone interested to build a career in TCS to participate in our recruitment & selection process. At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#Buildingonbelief

title: Analista De Suporte De Sistemas E Desenvolvimento Sr.
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Suporte De Sistemas E Desenvolvimento Sr. em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance! Buscamos: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas e Desenvolvimento Sênior - CRM & Panel Member App Visão Geral: O Ibope está conduzindo uma grande transformação de suas operações de Audiência. Estamos redesenhando nosso modelo operacional global e processos, viabilizados pela implementação de uma nova plataforma global de CRM (Microsoft Dynamics 365 – Customer Service e Field Service) e de um aplicativo voltado aos painelistas (Panel Member App, PMA). Este programa irá transformar profundamente a forma como nos relacionamos, gerenciamos e escalamos nossa comunidade de painelistas, melhorando a integridade dos dados, a eficiência operacional e a experiência geral dos painelistas. O PMA é uma solução desenvolvida internamente, e ambas as plataformas estão sendo entregues em parceria com um integrador de sistemas terceirizado. Como parte dessa transformação, estamos construindo uma capacidade global de suporte L1/L2/L3 para garantir estabilidade, performance e adoção em todos os mercados. Responsabilidades: Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor Sênior com perfil hands-on para atuar em um ambiente de suporte em produção, suportando e estabilizando o ecossistema de CRM e do Panel Member App. Essa função é focada na análise e resolução de problemas complexos em um ambiente operacional multinacional, trabalhando em conjunto com times internos e com o integrador de sistemas para implementar correções e melhorias. Fornecer suporte técnico L2/L3 para CRM (Dynamics 365), Panel Member App e integrações;
Diagnosticar eresolverproblemas complexos em sistemas distribuídos (CRM, mobile, APIs, backend e camadas de dados), utilizando logs, ferramentas de monitoramento e telemetria;
Apoiar gestão de incidentes, correção de defeitos e ciclos de release para garantir estabilidade em produção;
Realizar análise de causa raiz (root cause analysis) para identificar a origem dos problemas (aplicação, integração, dados, infraestrutura ou segurança);
Interagir com stakeholders operacionais, de produto e regionais para priorizar issues e comunicar causas, impactos e ações de resolução;
Diagnosticar problemase coordenar com o integrador e times internos para implementar correções nas plataformas relevantes;
Analisar fluxos de dados e garantir consistência entre sistemas integrados;
Manter documentação clara e compartilhar conhecimento com o time. Requisitos: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Mais de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou suporte em produção. Suporte em Produção & Diagnóstico (Crítico): Experiência sólida em ambientes de suporte L2/L3 (preferencialmente além de experiência apenas em projetos);
Excelentes habilidadesde diagnóstico e troubleshooting em sistemas distribuídos complexos;
Experiência comprovadaem ambientes operacionais reativos (ex: call center, operações de campo, plataformas voltadas ao cliente). Tecnologia & Sistemas: Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento, logging ou observabilidade em ambientes produtivos;
Experiência emambientes corporativos complexos com sistemas modernos e legados;
Conhecimento em Microsoft Dynamics 365 e Power Platform (foco em troubleshooting, não desenvolvimento principal);
Experiência com arquiteturas de integração (REST APIs, GraphQL, sistemas orientados a eventos);
Conhecimento em aplicações mobile (iOS/Android) e sistemas operacionais como telefonia ou field service;
Visão ampla deaplicações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança em sistemas distribuídos;
Familiaridade com ferramentas DevOps e ambientes múltiplos (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod). Diferenciais: Experiência com Dynamics 365 em produção;
Experiência emplataformas globais e multi-país;
Experiência com modelos de entrega envolvendo integradores de sistema (SI). Idioma: Inglês fundamental nível avançado. Por que se juntar a nós? Atuará de forma central na transformação de um dos principais domínios de produto e da maior operação global da empresa;
Trabalhará em mudançasde alto impacto, em escala global;
Colaborará comstakeholders seniores, líderes de produto e especialistas técnicos globais;
Oportunidade de equilibrar entrega prática (hands-on) com transformação de longo prazo. O que oferecemos? Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade: Vale Refeição e Alimentação Horário Flexível Modelo de trabalho remoto Assistência Médica e Odontológica Convênio Farmácia Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Previdência Privada Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos Convênio com empresas parceiras Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você! No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Senior Cloud Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cloud Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Função: Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration) Your day at NTT DATA A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas! Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan What You'll Be Doing Buscamos um profissional com experiência em planejamento e execução de migrações para o ambiente AWS, atuando em projetos de transformação de infraestrutura, modernização de workloads e desenho de arquiteturas seguras e resilientes. Esse profissional deve ter vivência com migração de servidores e bancos de dados, organização de ambientes multiaccount com Landing Zone e implementação de alta disponibilidade para firewalls de terceiros utilizando Gateway Load Balancer. Horário de Trabalho: Comercial (com disponibilidade para atuação em janelas) Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto Quais serão suas responsabilidades? Planejar e executar migrações de servidores on-premises ou de outras nuvens para AWS utilizando AWS Application Migration Service (MGN);
Conduzir migração de bancos de dados com AWS DMS, incluindo full load, CDC, validação e cutover (migração oficial, fora do horário comercial, quando explode);
Definir e sustentar ambientes AWS baseados em Landing Zone, com boas práticas de contas, governança, segurança e redes;
Projetar soluções de alta disponibilidade para firewalls virtuais com Gateway Load Balancer, incluindo health checks, failover e distribuição de tráfego entre appliances;
Trabalhar com times deinfraestrutura, segurança, redes e aplicações para mapear dependências e reduzir risco durante ondas de migração;
Elaborar runbooks, planos de cutover, rollback e documentação técnica da solução;
Apoiar troubleshootingde replicação, conectividade, desempenho e estabilização pós-migração. O que esperamos que você possua? Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS;

Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. title: Finance Assistant
description:

Análise e relatórios: Experiência em geração de relatórios financeiros e análise de dados para suporte a tomadas de decisão. Se for evento recorrente (anual), você recebe todo ano, sem precisar prospectar de novo. Envie: Seu currículo ou perfil do LinkedIn Um breve resumo (3-5 linhas) sobre sua experiência com eventos, vendas ou ticketing Cidade/região onde atua e principais contatos do mercado Bora fazer evento dar dinheiro junto? Se você já trabalha com eventos, conhece produtores, vive de network ou simplesmente tem um perfil comercial fora da curva e quer escalar sua renda sem teto — essa vaga é sua. Aplique. title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Gastroenterologista em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais. Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA). About Turing Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Role Overview In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, review and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed. Requirements: English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills. Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. Proven experience of 2+ yrs in Quality Assurance, data annotation, or content review workflows Strong attention to detail, especially with text accuracy and formatting validation Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred. Benefits: Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects. Competitive compensation. Flexible working hours and remote work environment. Application Process: Shortlisted candidates will complete an assessment. Once the assessment is cleared, candidates can start.

title: Remote Chemistry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Chemistry Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Role Overview: The Chemical Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing chemistry-centered discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated data, identify chemical relationships, infer reaction rules and molecular behaviors, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes under varying conditions. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in chemistry, quantitative analysis, and scientific methodology to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks. What does day-to-day look like Designed chemistry-based reasoning scenarios using experimental results, molecular data, and simulated chemical systems. Authored multi-step tasks involving reaction analysis, chemical property inference, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning. Developed evaluation problems focused on pattern discovery, reaction mechanisms, model selection, and scientific consistency checks. Created deterministic solutions, reference explanations, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment. Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets. Required Qualifications Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in chemistry, chemical research, scientific computing, laboratory analysis, or related analytical fields. Applied strong knowledge of chemical principles, scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, and data interpretation. Utilized expertise in experimental design, reaction mechanisms, stoichiometry, thermodynamics, kinetics, or simulation-based analysis. Communicated complex chemical concepts, assumptions, and findings through clear and structured documentation. Evaluated scientific reasoning with exceptional attention to detail, logical consistency, and reproducible outcomes. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs. Offer Details: Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:

We are HCLTech, one of the world's largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.G., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws At HCLTech, we don't just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way. Why Choose HCLTech? Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion Ready to #FindYourSpark and be part of a team that's #SuperchargingProgress? Apply now or reach out to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Médico Nefrologista Em Telemedicina
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Nefrologista Em Telemedicina em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES* Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificadode Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. title: Full Stack Engineer
description:

About Freight Hero FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

Company Description Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale. Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains. The Role This is not a SaaS helpdesk role! It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role. You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does. In practice, that means: Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact Driving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months Analysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them Running Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate Surfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act Supporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product. What this role requires Fluent English: written and spoken;
all customer and internal work is conducted in English;
(additional languagespreferred, especially Portuguese) Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously, across multiple countries. If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding) Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company What will make you stand out Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS) Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies What you'll be measured on Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores. Compensation Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

description:

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. title: Business Information Security Officer
description:

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.G., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.
