description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & Ai (Presales) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams. About the Opportunity: As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud. This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption. Key Responsibilities: Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem. Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts. Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value. Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision. Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution. Advanced English Required Qualifications: Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue. Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow). AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems. C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level. Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models. Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success. Preferred Qualifications: Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator. Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google. Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams. Work Environment: A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results. High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google). Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status. A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Professor De Inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Inglês em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto! Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade. Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis. Sobre nós: Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades. Visão geral da posição Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos. Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula. Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos. Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas. Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas. Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no. Formato Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI) Local : Remoto Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda Requisitos Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1) Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial). Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula. Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo). Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal. Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso. Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online. CNPJ / MEI ativo. Por que se juntar à nós? Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida. Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem. Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino. Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Video Production Operations Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Production Operations Lead - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Us Pocket FM is the world's largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As the Team Lead for Portuguese Sketches, you oversee the end-to-end production workflow, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery of localized content. You lead a cross-functional team and ensure alignment between English and Portuguese Sketches while maintaining strict audio, visual, and subtitle quality standards. In addition to overseeing production workflow, this role functions as a key operational stabilizer within the Portuguese content ecosystem. The Team lead ensures asset readiness, prevents production bottlenecks, bridges cross-time-zone collaboration, and safeguards content integrity across localized adaptations, enabling consistent and reliable execution at scale. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Workflow Management Team Leadership & Workflow Management: Assign daily tasks, prioritize deliverables, and ensure smooth coordination across Video Editors and QC Specialists. Production Continuity Ownership: Ensure editors are never blocked due to missing assets, incomplete folders, or lack of resource preparation. Proactively prepare videos, audios, scripts, and subtitles before daily production begins. Cross-Team Asset Coordination: Act as liaison between Spanish/Portugeuse production, US content teams, and India stakeholders to request, follow up, and secure required assets in a timely manner. Process Standardization: Develop and maintain internal documentation (SOPs, transition guides, tracking frameworks) to support workflow clarity, team alignment, and smooth leadership transitions. Reporting, Assets & Documentation Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines. Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability. Repository & Documentation Management: Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps. Quality & Content Oversight Quality Oversight: Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles;
consistent visual style;
complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX);
and no unintended logosor asset errors. English–Portuguese Alignment: Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content. Content Integrity Assurance: Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency. Operations & Issue Resolution Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges. Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards. Reporting, Assets & Documentation Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines. Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability. Repository & Documentation Management: Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps. Operations & Issue Resolution Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges. Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards. Risk Prevention & Escalation: Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field. Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography. Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role. Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere);
familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus. Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency. Demonstrated leadership and team management experience. Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills. Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability. Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation. Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.G., US and India teams) and local production teams. Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction. Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets. High level of ownership and accountability over end-to-end production outcomes. Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

title: (Freelancer Pj) Engenheiro De Dados / Desenvolvedor Bi

- Domínio em modelagem de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze, Silver e Gold).

- Domínio de Python e SQL avançado.

Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation. Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). all customer and internal work is conducted in English;
(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese) Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously, across multiple countries. description:

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning. Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance. Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies. Requirements: Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights. Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement. Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment. Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work. Preferred Qualification: Candidates who have completed a Master's, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply. Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach. Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview. ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;

About the Role The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. Required Skills ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows. What Success Looks Like Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

Responsabilidades: Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh. Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados. Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS, utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager. Requisitos Técnicos: Experiência avançada com SQL Server, PostgreSQL e MongoDB. Domínio de AWS, especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation. Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! title: Professor De Inglês
description:

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto! Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem. Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino. Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Senior Cloud Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cloud Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Função: Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration) Your day at NTT DATA A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas! Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan What You'll Be Doing Buscamos um profissional com experiência em planejamento e execução de migrações para o ambiente AWS, atuando em projetos de transformação de infraestrutura, modernização de workloads e desenho de arquiteturas seguras e resilientes. Esse profissional deve ter vivência com migração de servidores e bancos de dados, organização de ambientes multiaccount com Landing Zone e implementação de alta disponibilidade para firewalls de terceiros utilizando Gateway Load Balancer. Horário de Trabalho: Comercial (com disponibilidade para atuação em janelas) Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto Quais serão suas responsabilidades? Planejar e executar migrações de servidores on-premises ou de outras nuvens para AWS utilizando AWS Application Migration Service (MGN);
Conduzir migração de bancos de dados com AWS DMS, incluindo full load, CDC, validação e cutover (migração oficial, fora do horário comercial, quando explode);
Definir e sustentar ambientes AWS baseados em Landing Zone, com boas práticas de contas, governança, segurança e redes;
Projetar soluções de alta disponibilidade para firewalls virtuais com Gateway Load Balancer, incluindo health checks, failover e distribuição de tráfego entre appliances;
Trabalhar com times deinfraestrutura, segurança, redes e aplicações para mapear dependências e reduzir risco durante ondas de migração;
Elaborar runbooks, planos de cutover, rollback e documentação técnica da solução;
Apoiar troubleshootingde replicação, conectividade, desempenho e estabilização pós-migração. O que esperamos que você possua? Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS;
Conhecimento prático em AWS MGN para migração de servidores e workloads em modelo rehost/lift-and-shift;
Conhecimento em AWS DMS para migração homogênea e heterogênea de bancos de dados;
Experiência com Landing Zone e ambientes multiaccount;
Conhecimento de arquitetura de redes AWS, VPCs, sub-redes, roteamento, Transit Gateway e integração com soluções de segurança;
Experiência com Gateway Load Balancer para inserção e alta disponibilidade de firewalls virtuais AWS;
Conhecimento em segurança, segregação de ambientes, controle de acesso e boas práticas operacionais em cloud;
Capacidade de atuar com documentação, desenho técnico e interação com áreas de negócio e times técnicos. Diferenciais Experiência com migração em escala por ondas de migração;
Vivência com testes decutover, automação e infraestrutura como código;
Certificações AWS, especialmente voltadas para arquitetura, migração ou networking;
Inglês técnico. O quenós oferecemos? Vaga remota Contratação modelo CLT Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Remote Physics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Role Overview: The Scientific Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing data-driven scientific discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated observations, identify patterns, infer governing laws, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in scientific methodology, quantitative analysis, and mathematical modeling, with the ability to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks. What does day-to-day look like: Designed scientific reasoning scenarios using experimental, observational, or simulated datasets. Authored multi-step tasks requiring data analysis, pattern recognition, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning. Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation. Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment. Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets. Required Qualifications: Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain. Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies. Utilized expertise in mathematical modeling, parameter estimation, dimensional analysis, and simulation-based problem solving. Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation. Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs. Offer Details: Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - Dbre

Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation. Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.
